text:
maya: Heads-up — I just opened a quota request for a multi-zone GPU pool that we need for the new inference burst tests. Need approvals + a short justification for billing. Details below.

maya: Requested quotas:
- A100 (v4) regional quota: +24 GPUs across us-west1/us-central1
- H100 (v2) spare pool: +12 GPUs in us-west1 (for dedicated bursts)
- L4 (preemptible) capacity: +40 instances in us-central1
- External IP (ephemeral) increase: +150 in us-west1
- Network egress (30/100 Gbps) uplift for project networking path

maya: Reasoning: we need deterministic throughput for our multi-zone canary and cost testing. We'll use A100s for large-batch offline scoring, H100s for low-latency P99 tests, L4 as fallbacks and cheaper burst capacity. External IPs are for GPU nodes that must reach partner endpoints during warmup.

raj: pinging @sasha for the VPC/shared VPC approvals — do we need org-level permissions for service project attach?

sasha: Yes — we'll need the host project to have Service Project Peering enabled and sharedVPC attach rights for the service account. I submitted the terraform change, but org admin still needs to flip the sharedVPC grant.

maya: @sasha can you paste the IAM snippet you need?

sasha: Sure — the minimal IAM change we asked for:
```
resource "google_project_iam_binding" "svc_attach" {
  project = "projects/123456789012" # host project
  role    = "roles/compute.xpnAdmin"
  members = ["serviceAccount:infra-pools@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
}
```

kevin: cost note: Estimated monthly delta if all GPUs are active ~ $220k (on-demand) — but we expect <30% avg utilization for bursts, so likely ~$70k/mo. Need finance sign-off for the burst budget.

maya: Submitted the quota form with GCP (request id: Q-2026-07-4921). Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas?project=redwood-inference&request=Q-2026-07-4921

quota-bot: Quota request Q-2026-07-4921 created by maya. Current status: PENDING ORG REVIEW. ETA: 3-5 business days.

raj: Also flagging the egress: partner legal requires that egress traffic to partner endpoints be limited to dedicated IPs to audit flows. That’s why we need reserved external IP headroom. @elaine handled partner terms — any blockers?

elaine: Legal is okay with the networking pattern but we need to record the partner IP allowlist and ensure we have an SLA clause. I'll send a short memo.

maya: Ops notes for the approval thread:
- We will create a separate billing sub-account for the burst pool and tag all nodes with billing tags.
- Autoscaler will only increase to the A100/H100 pool with explicit rollout flags.
- Fallback policy: if H100 capacity not available, route to L4 preemptible set.

raj: If org admin approves sharedVPC, we also need the compute API and quota APIs enabled in the host project. I added a small checklist:
- [x] Billing account linked to project
- [ ] Enable compute.googleapis.com
- [ ] Enable serviceusage.googleapis.com
- [ ] Shared VPC IAM grant (xpnAdmin)

maya: Can someone help push org approval? Tagging infra-admins: @sasha, @kevin — we need the org-level sign-off to avoid GCP requesting more justification.

sasha: I'll escalate to org-admins. I already DM'd them the terraform PR + quota request id.

kevin: Finance is provisionally approved for up to $80k/mo for experimental bursts. If actual spend approaches $120k/mo we need a re-approval. Please ensure cost alerts and budgets are in place.

maya: Thanks — I'll add budget alerts and quota usage dashboards in Console. Also adding a doc in drive for the rollout playbook.

quota-bot: Update: Q-2026-07-4921 status changed to AWAITING ORG_APPROVAL (requested by admin).

maya: Great. After org approval we should get GCP to split A100 regional quota across us-west1/us-central1 rather than per-project so we can autoscale pools across zones.

raj: Quick reminder — if we get A100 regional quota, we still need per-zone EIP capacity for node bootstrap in each zone. Add per-zone external IPs to the request if they ask.

maya: Updated the GCP form with per-zone EIP counts and a short cost justification. New link: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas?project=redwood-inference&request=Q-2026-07-4921&view=details

elaine: I'll add the partner memo to the ticket for audit.

maya: Thanks all — please react with :thumbsup: once you have sign-off so I can mark the request as approved and schedule the burst window.

sasha: :thumbsup:

kevin: :thumbsup:

raj: :thumbsup:

quota-bot: Final status (so far): PENDING ORG_APPROVAL -> AWAITING ADMIN. Next steps: org admin approval then quota provisioning. Estimated completion after admin approval: 48 hours.
